handback.title: Code groups criteria into stories by shared files
handback.summary: Code works out the stories from the files each criterion changes, and no count rule remains.
handback.user_story: Any ask, however big, splits into stories by the code files its criteria change, never by counting.

acceptance_criteria.text: Code puts criteria that share a code file, directly or through another criterion, into one story.
acceptance_criteria.words: Code groups criteria that share any code file into one story (a sub-issue).

edge_cases.case: Two criteria joined only through a third criterion that shares a file with each.
A non-functional requirement shares a code file with an acceptance criterion.

acceptance_criteria.text: Code puts criteria with no code file in common into separate stories.
acceptance_criteria.words: Criteria with no file in common become separate stories.

edge_cases.case: Two unrelated criteria whose edge cases are tested in one test file.

acceptance_criteria.text: No count of criteria or stories refuses a plan.
acceptance_criteria.words: No number decides it: no criteria cap, no story cap.

edge_cases.case: A story with no criteria is still refused.
A story of a parent holds six criteria on one code file.

acceptance_criteria.text: The planner's and reviewer's instructions no longer state the old count rules.
acceptance_criteria.words: This replaces today's count-based split rules
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: It is fixed text with no input, so nothing varies.

acceptance_criteria.text: Two criteria that share only a markdown file stay in separate stories.
acceptance_criteria.words: Markdown files never group criteria and never make a story wait.

edge_cases.case: Two criteria list only the same markdown file and no code file.

test_changes.tests/test_size_rule.py::test_a_story_ov: Only the empty cases stay, since caps go; the name stays for the moved list.
test_changes.tests/test_size_rule.py::test_the_right_: Docstring no longer states the five criteria cap.
test_changes.tests/test_size_rule.py::test_a_story_of: Keeps one level but drops the six criteria refusal, as caps go.
test_changes.tests/test_criterion_files.py::test_each: Its sample criteria now share a file, so they form one story.
test_changes.tests/test_criterion_files.py::test_a_cr: Its sample criteria now share a file, so they form one story.
test_changes.tests/test_criterion_files.py::test_a_fi: Its sample criteria now share a file, so they form one story.
test_changes.tests/test_plan_shape.py::test_a_feature: Its two sample stories now change different files, as grouping requires.

raises.label: Regroup on scope growth
raises.text: Regrouping a grown story's new criteria under its parent is new work. File it separately? The plan assumes so.
raises.evidence: Owner's comment of 2026-10-14 on #667 asks it; this story already holds five criteria, today's most.

answers.why: The test for 667.4 now also fails on 'at most 5' and 'at most five criteria'.
The test for 667.1 now groups a non-functional requirement with the criterion it shares a code file with.
